integrity: The representation decompositions were reconstructed independently from the published character table with exact arithmetic. Computational output is used only to replay finite character calculations; the selection-rule implication is proved analytically.
scientific_limitations: The result is a symmetry-only selection statement; allowed intertwiners may vanish for specially tuned seeds.
It does not optimize coherent-state seeds, fidelity, energy, or recovery maps.
It classifies only the six two-dimensional logical representations listed for the binary-octahedral example in the source.
title: A sharp symmetry-only gate–loss tradeoff for binary-octahedral bosonic qubits
